name: Warrior
description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

name: Wizard
description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the fabric of reality through arcane spells.

name: Cleric
description: A divine spellcaster who channels the power of their deity to heal and protect allies.

name: Thief
description: A cunning rogue who relies on stealth, agility, and precision strikes.

name: Bard
description: A charismatic performer who weaves magic through music and storytelling.

name: Ranger
description: A skilled tracker and archer at home in the wilderness.
